entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I gave the Bludish minority what t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I gave the Bludish minority what they wanted for decades. An autonomous Bergia!"
entries.menuText: "I gave the Bludish minority what they wanted for decades. An autonomous Bergia!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I worked hard to expand the rights..."
entries.dialogueText: "I worked hard to expand the rights of our minorities. I formed a commission for Bludish rights and gave amnesty to all Bluds prosecuted for their ethnicity."
entries.menuText: "I worked hard to expand the rights of our minorities. I formed a commission for Bludish rights and gave amnesty to all Bluds prosecuted for their ethnicity."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We brought free public transportat..."
entries.dialogueText: "We brought free public transportation to all Sordish citizens!"
entries.menuText: "We brought free public transportation to all Sordish citizens!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I stood in the way of the ultranat..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stood in the way of the ultranationalists and I crushed every bill that sought to undermine the Bludish people."
entries.menuText: "I stood in the way of the ultranationalists and I crushed every bill that sought to undermine the Bludish people."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""With increased control over the Ce..."
entries.dialogueText: "With increased control over the Central Bank, Sordland will be much swifter in taking action against economic turmoil."
entries.menuText: "With increased control over the Central Bank, Sordland will be much swifter in taking action against economic turmoil."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We now give housing assistance to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We now give housing assistance to all Sordish citizens who need it. We're one step closer to eliminating homelessness!"
entries.menuText: "We now give housing assistance to all Sordish citizens who need it. We're one step closer to eliminating homelessness!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Today, every unemployed Sordish ci..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, every unemployed Sordish citizen is entitled to government assistance until they find a job."
entries.menuText: "Today, every unemployed Sordish citizen is entitled to government assistance until they find a job."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have always had the best interes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have always had the best interests of our people at heart, and I will continue to do so."
entries.menuText: "I have always had the best interests of our people at heart, and I will continue to do so."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""One of our historic achievements w..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of our historic achievements was to pay off all student debts. We erased it completely."
entries.menuText: "One of our historic achievements was to pay off all student debts. We erased it completely."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""In the face of foreign interventio..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the face of foreign intervention and internal militants, we enacted new security laws and eliminated the threats."
entries.menuText: "In the face of foreign intervention and internal militants, we enacted new security laws and eliminated the threats."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""By establishing the Free Trade Com..."
entries.dialogueText: "By establishing the Free Trade Commission, we ensured healthy competition, so that our citizens can buy higher-quality products for less."
entries.menuText: "By establishing the Free Trade Commission, we ensured healthy competition, so that our citizens can buy higher-quality products for less."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I worked long and hard to ensure a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I worked long and hard to ensure a brighter future for our country and our people."
entries.menuText: "I worked long and hard to ensure a brighter future for our country and our people."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My term saw a great expansion of w..."
entries.dialogueText: "My term saw a great expansion of women's rights. Sordish women now finally have a voice."
entries.menuText: "My term saw a great expansion of women's rights. Sordish women now finally have a voice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""In the last four years, the women..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the last four years, the women of this country won a decades-long fight against the patriarchy."
entries.menuText: "In the last four years, the women of this country won a decades-long fight against the patriarchy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I de-segregated our education syst..."
entries.dialogueText: "I de-segregated our education system which had deep roots in misogyny. Now every Sordish student is equal."
entries.menuText: "I de-segregated our education system which had deep roots in misogyny. Now every Sordish student is equal."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I heard the pleas of our women and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I heard the pleas of our women and acted to represent their rights. I enacted laws that protect and liberate the women of this great nation."
entries.menuText: "I heard the pleas of our women and acted to represent their rights. I enacted laws that protect and liberate the women of this great nation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The truth is, I have done my part..."
entries.dialogueText: "The truth is, I have done my part for this country. And I am proud of what I achieved."
entries.menuText: "The truth is, I have done my part for this country. And I am proud of what I achieved."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The truth is, it is important to l..."
entries.dialogueText: "The truth is, it is important to let go and allow new leadership to take the reigns."
entries.menuText: "The truth is, it is important to let go and allow new leadership to take the reigns."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My dear citizens, this has been th..."
entries.dialogueText: "My dear citizens, this has been the greatest honor bestowed upon me as a fellow countryman."
entries.menuText: "My dear citizens, this has been the greatest honor bestowed upon me as a fellow countryman."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""At the end of my term, I will be e..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the end of my term, I will be ending my political career for personal reasons."
entries.menuText: "At the end of my term, I will be ending my political career for personal reasons."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have demonstrated that Sordland..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have demonstrated that Sordland can improve as a society. Never lose hope, my fellow citizens."
entries.menuText: "I have demonstrated that Sordland can improve as a society. Never lose hope, my fellow citizens."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I gave my heart and soul to serve..."
entries.dialogueText: "I gave my heart and soul to serve this beautiful nation."
entries.menuText: "I gave my heart and soul to serve this beautiful nation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our people are great and unique. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our people are great and unique. We are destined for great things."
entries.menuText: "Our people are great and unique. We are destined for great things."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I wish my successor the best of lu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish my successor the best of luck. For this is the greatest test of oneself."
entries.menuText: "I wish my successor the best of luck. For this is the greatest test of oneself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sordland must walk the path of mal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland must walk the path of malenyevism to achieve true parity in society."
entries.menuText: "Sordland must walk the path of malenyevism to achieve true parity in society."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our nation should adopt the middle..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our nation should adopt the middle-ground solution of Valgslandian socialism to advance."
entries.menuText: "Our nation should adopt the middle-ground solution of Valgslandian socialism to advance."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This country can combine strong el..."
entries.dialogueText: "This country can combine strong elements of socialism and democracy to provide an alternative."
entries.menuText: "This country can combine strong elements of socialism and democracy to provide an alternative."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'd like to make a statement regar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to make a statement regarding the future of the country."
entries.menuText: "I'd like to make a statement regarding the future of the country."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'd like to conclude on that note.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to conclude on that note."
entries.menuText: "I'd like to conclude on that note."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Colonel has provided a differe..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Colonel has provided a different and stronger path for the future of Sordland. One we should follow."
entries.menuText: "The Colonel has provided a different and stronger path for the future of Sordland. One we should follow."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our society, culture and the value..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our society, culture and the values Sords represent must be at the forefront of any governance."
entries.menuText: "Our society, culture and the values Sords represent must be at the forefront of any governance."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our country is great as is and the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our country is great as is and there is little reason to make a drastic change to steer from this course."
entries.menuText: "Our country is great as is and there is little reason to make a drastic change to steer from this course."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sordland can enrich itself and be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland can enrich itself and be part of a new world order with an incentive-driven capitalist structure."
entries.menuText: "Sordland can enrich itself and be part of a new world order with an incentive-driven capitalist structure."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our nation must unlock the ambitio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our nation must unlock the ambitions and potentials of individuals with material rewards to compete with the world."
entries.menuText: "Our nation must unlock the ambitions and potentials of individuals with material rewards to compete with the world."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It is possible to find balance in..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is possible to find balance in the system of the west and still achieve high living standards for many."
entries.menuText: "It is possible to find balance in the system of the west and still achieve high living standards for many."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sordland should be a beacon of lib..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland should be a beacon of liberty and democracy. We can cherish our idealistic values."
entries.menuText: "Sordland should be a beacon of liberty and democracy. We can cherish our idealistic values."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our country should provide all typ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our country should provide all types of freedoms and allow for safe transition of power regardless of who the people choose."
entries.menuText: "Our country should provide all types of freedoms and allow for safe transition of power regardless of who the people choose."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Whichever way Sordland may evolve..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whichever way Sordland may evolve to, democracy must take a part in the form of government."
entries.menuText: "Whichever way Sordland may evolve to, democracy must take a part in the form of government."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We wrote history when we celebrate..."
entries.dialogueText: "We wrote history when we celebrated our changes to the outdated Constitution of 1929."
entries.menuText: "We wrote history when we celebrated our changes to the outdated Constitution of 1929."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We have amended our once-untouchab..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have amended our once-untouchable constitution and opened the way for further reforms."
entries.menuText: "We have amended our once-untouchable constitution and opened the way for further reforms."
